summary: Implemented WP-021: External VLC Context Menu in MoviesListView. Added IExternalPlayerService injection, ExternalPlayerAvailable observable property, PlayExternalCommand and PlayFullscreenExternalCommand with CanExecute guards, context-menu items in AXAML, and factory wiring in Program.cs. 12 new unit tests added. Build: 0 warnings, 0 errors. Tests: 448/448 passed.

comments.note: The existing PlayMovieCommand and PlayMovieFullscreenCommand (embedded-player no-ops) in MoviesListViewModel could be renamed to better distinguish them from the new VLC external-player commands. Currently named 'Play' in AXAML vs 'Play in VLC' which is clear enough, but the ViewModel command names PlayMovieCommand vs PlayExternalCommand are inconsistent in style.

SelectedMovies setter now calls NotifyCanExecuteChanged for PlayExternalCommand and PlayFullscreenExternalCommand, but the pre-existing GenerateThumbnailsCommand's CanExecute (CanGenerateThumbnails) still has no automatic notification mechanism when SelectedMovies changes. This is a pre-existing issue not introduced by this WP.

ExternalPlayerAvailable is computed once at construction time from IExternalPlayerService.CanUseExternalPlayer. If VLC settings change at runtime, the property won't update. This is acceptable for the current milestone since settings changes require app restart, but a future WP could subscribe to settings change events to re-evaluate.

summary: QA PASS for WP-021 (External VLC Context Menu in MoviesListView). Full verification stack executed: build clean, all 15 external-player tests pass (12 in MoviesListViewModelExternalPlayerTests + 3 in DesktopExternalPlayerServiceTests), full regression suite of 486 App.Tests pass (0 failures, 0 skipped). All 4 acceptance criteria verified. Context-menu IsVisible bindings, CanPlayExternal guard, DesktopExternalPlayerService.CanUseExternalPlayer=false when UseVlc=false, and Program.cs DI wiring all confirmed correct.

comments.note: No test covers SelectedMovies.Count > 1 — the CanPlayExternal guard requires Count == 1, but no test verifies the multi-selection path explicitly. The single-selection and zero-selection paths are tested; the multi-selection block is a minor coverage gap, not a bug.

The separator between standard and VLC items (MoviesListView.axaml line 68) correctly has IsVisible={Binding ExternalPlayerAvailable}, so no orphaned separator appears when VLC is disabled. This is a good UI practice confirmed by code review.

summary: PASS with Fix-Forward. WP-021 External VLC Context Menu is well-implemented with correct MVVM patterns, proper DI wiring, and sound CanExecute guard logic. Applied one non-behavioral refactor: extracted the duplicated file-path resolution block shared by PlayExternalAsync and PlayFullscreenExternalAsync into a private ResolveExternalPlayerFilePathAsync helper. Build: 0 warnings/0 errors. All 12 external-player tests pass post-refactor.

comments.note: Extracted duplicated file-path resolution logic from PlayExternalAsync and PlayFullscreenExternalAsync into a new private helper ResolveExternalPlayerFilePathAsync(CancellationToken). Both command methods were identical for ~10 lines (GetCurrentFilePathsAsync call, TryGetValue check, LogWarning, return). The helper returns string? — null on failure — so each command method reduces to a null-guard and the single service call. Build and all 12 tests pass post-refactor. Behavior is unchanged.

CanPlayExternal() re-evaluates _externalPlayerService?.CanUseExternalPlayer == true live, while ExternalPlayerAvailable (the bound UI property) is cached once at construction. The two are consistent in practice because VLC settings require app restart, but they are semantically separate: one drives UI visibility, the other drives command execution. No change needed — this dual-gate is actually defensive.

[documentation-forward] The SelectedMovies property has an explanatory <remarks> block explaining why it is public rather than internal, but there is no XML summary tag on the property itself. Adding a <summary> tag would make it immediately discoverable via IntelliSense without reading the remarks. Consider adding: 'Multi-selection list populated by the SelectionChanged code-behind handler. See remarks for testability rationale.'

notes:
WP-021 is fully implemented. Key items for QA:
1. ExternalPlayerAvailable is false when IExternalPlayerService is not injected or CanUseExternalPlayer=false; true otherwise.
2. PlayExternalCommand and PlayFullscreenExternalCommand CanExecute guard: SelectedMovies.Count == 1 AND CanUseExternalPlayer == true.
3. Context menu shows 'Play in VLC' and 'Play Fullscreen in VLC' items (plus a separator) — all three have IsVisible={Binding ExternalPlayerAvailable}.
4. Commands resolve file path from IMovieRepository.GetCurrentFilePathsAsync before calling IExternalPlayerService.Play/PlayFullscreen.
5. 12 unit tests cover all AC paths.

WP-021 passes QA. Build: 0 warnings/0 errors. All 4 ACs met. 486 App.Tests pass with no regressions. Key points for code review: (1) CanPlayExternal guard in MoviesListViewModel is count==1 AND service.CanUseExternalPlayer, properly wired to both commands. (2) AXAML context menu separator + Play in VLC + Play Fullscreen in VLC all share IsVisible={Binding ExternalPlayerAvailable}. (3) Program.cs wires IExternalPlayerService via GetRequiredService. Minor note: no test for Count > 1 multi-select scenario (low-priority coverage gap).
